structuredContent.name: tenants.add-user-to-tenant
structuredContent.description: Add a user to an active tenant with a role. Allowed for a global administrator or a TenantOwner of the tenant; if the tenant has never had a member, any caller may add its first member with any role. A user who is already a member is rejected; use tenants.change-user-role to change an existing member's role.

TenantId.description: Identifier of the tenant to add the user to.

UserId.description: Identifier of the user to add: the subject (sub) claim the identity provider issues for that user. It is not checked against the identity provider.

Role.description: Role to grant. Every role can read the tenant and its members; TenantContributor can also update its name and description; TenantOwner can also manage its members, roles and configuration. Unknown is rejected.
